changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: UPDATE notifications SET destination_push_token = NULL WHERE channel = 'PUSH';

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_devices_coordinate_legacy_push_token_update BEFORE UPDATE OF push_token ON devices FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.push_token IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.push_token) EXECUTE FUNCTION coordinate_legacy_push_token_update();

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_devices_coordinate_legacy_push_token_update ON devices;

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notifications_scrub_push_token_snapshot BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF channel, destination_push_token ON notifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION scrub_push_notification_token_snapshot();
UPDATE notifications SET destination_push_token = NULL WHERE channel = 'PUSH';

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_notifications_scrub_push_token_snapshot ON notifications;

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_due_push_delivery ON notifications (push_next_attempt_at, id) WHERE is_deleted = false AND channel = 'PUSH' AND status = 'QUEUED' AND (push_attempt_count > 0 OR failure_reason = 'TOKEN_SERIALIZATION_BUSY');

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_stale_push_delivery ON notifications (push_processing_started_at, id) WHERE is_deleted = false AND channel = 'PUSH' AND status = 'PROCESSING';

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_anonymization_coordinate_legacy_push BEFORE INSERT ON account_anonymization_audit FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION coordinate_legacy_account_anonymization_start();

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_account_anonymization_coordinate_legacy_push ON account_anonymization_audit;
